reason: Hazard V3 retained row-level economic fills, so later fills in the same Polygon block could be treated as future observations. This violates the frozen block-end observability rule.
observed_dev_result_note: V3 appeared strong on DEV, but those metrics are excluded from selection and conclusions.
correction: V4 aggregates all contemporaneous fields to condition-block-end and requires the target price change to occur in a strictly later Polygon block.
fresh_confirmation_status: V4 is a corrected DEV rerun, not fresh confirmation.
